periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward angle relative to the horizontal facial axis, directed toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval profile with a high vertical-to-horizontal ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinctive downward taper where the lower margin of the patch extends significantly further from the eye center than the upper margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped profile across the posterior margin of the shoulder band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High; the band covers approximately 45% of the visible upper torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separated by the cranial dome, with the gap between ears measuring roughly 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly convex and rounded at the superior boundaries.
